How to choose Cash+ categories; selection timing

rewardsSummary.category: 5% choice categories ("two categories you choose" each quarter) from: "Fast food", "Home utilities", "TV, internet & streaming services", "Department stores", "Cell phone providers", "Electronics stores", "Sporting goods stores", "Furniture stores", "Movie theaters", "Ground transportation", "Gyms/fitness centers", "Select clothing stores"
rewardsSummary.cap: first $2,000 in combined eligible net purchases each quarter across both 5% categories, then 1%
rewardsSummary.conditions: Cardholder must choose and activate categories each quarter (Rewards Center, mobile app, or phone); selection opens 45 days before the quarter; categories lock 5 days before the quarter starts; choices do not roll over automatically per FAQ ('you must reselect'); if no choice is made all purchases earn 1%. Category membership is by merchant category code; exclusions per category (e.g. Department stores excludes Walmart, Target, Costco, Sears.com; Electronics stores excludes telecom carriers and discount stores; TV/streaming excludes PayPal, Google Play, Amazon, iTunes). Category list 'subject to change on a quarterly basis'.

rewardsSummary.category: 2% everyday choice category ("one everyday category you choose each quarter") from: "Grocery stores and grocery delivery", "Restaurants", "Gas stations and EV charging stations"
rewardsSummary.cap: none stated (FAQ: 'no limits on your 2% or 1% cash back earnings')
rewardsSummary.conditions: Chosen quarterly with the 5% picks. Grocery excludes discount stores/supercenters and wholesale clubs (Walmart, Target, warehouse clubs).

rewardsSummary.category: "Prepaid travel": air, hotel and car reservations booked directly in the U.S. Bank Travel Center with this card
rewardsSummary.conditions: Footnote: base 1% plus 'an additional 4% cash back' on prepaid air, car and hotel reservations in the Travel Center.

cards.checkoutRelevance: Yes: "Electronics Stores" 5% choice category; issuer sample-merchant list names Best Buy, Bestbuy.com and Newegg.com. Amazon.com is not listed in any category (earns 1%; Amazon excluded from TV/streaming).
cards.notes: Sign-up: $200 bonus after $1,000 in eligible purchases in first 90 days (product page). Cash rewards expire end of calendar month 36 months after billing cycle earned. Category list shown on product page matches samplemerchants page as of 2026-10-01; issuer says options can change quarterly. Newegg.com MCC classification is per issuer sample list, actual coding may vary.
